content.py holds 185 sprite entries, about 29 sound sets, animations, weapon specs, pickups

inspiration: Parts-based character: a tee is a stack of parts (body, markings, decoration, hands, feet, eyes, hats), each with a sprite grid and a tint setting. Frankendom: greyscale base parts tinted per part; armour plates tinted from a metal ramp.
Recolour picker in the settings menu: a hue-saturation-lightness picker (CMenus::RenderHSLPicker) for part tints. Frankendom: one picker per part with a live preview.
Three-frame weapon muzzle: three muzzle sprites used in turn for one attack. Frankendom: a short three-frame flash per attack.
Keyframe slash: six keyframes on normalised time with a fast snap through the middle and rest at both ends. Frankendom: a windup that snaps and settles, readable at 375 px.
Chain as a repeated link sprite with a separate head sprite for the hook. Frankendom: a tether drawn from a repeated link along the line.
Energy bar built from a left cap, fill and right cap in full and empty variants. Frankendom: a segmented stamina gauge for the hud topic.
Splat left behind at death: a particle splat plus a 64 px dead-tee sprite. Frankendom: a dim, non-gory mark for row 17 and row 8.
Numbered sound variant families (2 to 3 per event). Frankendom: a variant pool per event so the same hit is not heard twice in a row.

briefs.label: Ninja slash arc
briefs.why: a short windup and a snap that settles gives one readable motion that fits a fast duel at 375 px
keep: six-keyframe attack with windup, fast snap and rest at both ends
change: a two-part curved blade with a glow trail
sounds from our own foley set

briefs.label: Rune tether
briefs.why: a tether made of repeated links is readable across a fight and shows where a pull comes from
keep: one link sprite repeated along the line
separate head sprite at the end

briefs.label: Parts-tinted fighter
briefs.why: a character made of tinted parts can be recoloured per player with a few numbers

each part has its own tint
change: armour plates tinted from a metal ramp, not hue and saturation triples
eyes are a visor slit with a team glow

briefs.label: Segmented energy bar
